content: Task ledger update: Hermes Discord governed task request surface implemented. Added /task action:propose and /task action:request_run to the main Discord bot. Propose appends an explicit operator-origin queued task to core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl; request_run writes annunimas.hermes.work_stream_task_run_request.v1 receipts to data/hermes/work_stream_requests.jsonl and does not execute terminal work directly. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes -- --test-threads=1.
